mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Other Super and starting skill for the Mixed fighting-style choice. The user enters an afterimage pose; with correct timing, the move can evade an incoming attack and reposition the user behind a nearby opponent, while attacks from farther away can be evaded through the movement. Exact invulnerability timing and teleport distance remain version-sensitive.
evidence_limits: Exact frames/timing/tracking, patch-independent damage values, and unresolved reward probabilities or gates are not promoted without direct support.
